description: HOTOSM Railways (OpenStreetMap Export) by country (Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team, on HDX) is a series of datasets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). OpenStreetMap exports for use in GIS applications. This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching: railway IN ('rail','station') Features may have these attributes: - ele - layer - railway - addr:full - operator:type - addr:city - source - name This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX. Coverage: 7 countries and territories, one dataset each (for example Cocos (Keeling) Islands, Christmas Island, Gibraltar, Heard Island and McDonald Islands). The portal lists 7 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Its tags are facilities-infrastructure, geodata, railways, transportation. It offers 6 resource(s) in GARMIN IMG, GEOPACKAGE, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODC-ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
